# IT Security Protocol and Database Migration Standards

This document outlines key tasks and reviews for the IT & Digital department.

*   Review encryption standards based on recent audit findings.
*   Optimize database migration processes with urgency.
*   Monitor firewall settings to align with strategy 2026.
*   Update database migration standards.
*   Update encryption standards on a quarterly basis.
